---
title: Given-only author names
author:
  - given: Plato
  - name: Ada Lovelace
format:
  html: default
  jats: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<p>Plato\s*</p>', '<p>Ada Lovelace\s*</p>']
        - []
    jats:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<given-names>Plato</given-names>', '<surname>Lovelace</surname>']
        - ['<surname>Plato</surname>']
---

An author written with only a given name must be kept, and must not take the given name as a family name.

- `Plato` is a flat object with only `given`: it is a recognized author, not an unknown shape.
- `Ada Lovelace` is a plain string next to it: a recognized author must not be dropped because of its neighbour.
